# Vadim Vladymtsev

> Enterprise AI CTO and product operator. CTO at StackLevel Group.

English-language enterprise AI, technical due diligence and CTO advisory for audiences in the United States and the United Arab Emirates (UAE). Geographic focus is not a claim of offices or residence.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://vadimohka.com/): Vadim Vladymtsev, CTO at StackLevel Group. Enterprise AI strategy, product architecture, technical due diligence and CTO advisory for USA and UAE audiences.
- [About & Contact](https://vadimohka.com/about.html): Meet Vadim Vladymtsev, CTO at StackLevel Group. Product architecture, enterprise AI and technical judgment. Contact routes for USA and UAE business inquiries.
- [Century AI Studio](https://vadimohka.com/century.html): Explore Century AI Studio: assistants, workflows, protected data access, private deployment and operational controls for enterprise AI. Product context and sources.
- [Enterprise AI](https://vadimohka.com/enterprise.html): Enterprise AI strategy and architecture with Vadim Vladymtsev. Use-case selection, data boundaries, governance and production planning for USA and UAE organizations.
- [AI Technical Due Diligence](https://vadimohka.com/investors.html): AI technical due diligence for investors in the USA and UAE. Assess product, data, architecture, security, team and deployment risks with Vadim Vladymtsev.
- [CTO Advisory](https://vadimohka.com/founders.html): CTO advisory for founders and executive teams in the USA and UAE. Align product, architecture, ownership and engineering delivery with a focused technical diagnostic.
- [Media & Speaking](https://vadimohka.com/expert.html): Enterprise AI speaker and technical expert Vadim Vladymtsev. Original essays, speaking topics, short biographies and contact routes for editors and event organizers.
- [Selected Work](https://vadimohka.com/work.html): Explore Vadim Vladymtsev’s enterprise AI work: Century product context, original essays, engineering experience and technical leadership.
- [Sources](https://vadimohka.com/sources.html): Product information, professional profiles, public code, research and a learning credential connected with Vadim Vladymtsev’s work.
- [Essays](https://vadimohka.com/essays/): Original essays by Vadim Vladymtsev on software architecture, AI at work, shared understanding, project communities and authorship.
- [Revising an Architecture I Designed](https://vadimohka.com/essays/revising-my-architecture/): What rebuilding part of my own microservices application taught me about engineering responsibility, migration costs, and professional trust.
- [Who Gets the Time AI Saves?](https://vadimohka.com/essays/who-gets-the-time-ai-saves/): AI can make a task faster. The value depends on who receives the time saved and what the company enables them to do with it.
- [Shared Understanding Takes Work](https://vadimohka.com/essays/shared-understanding/): What coaching a competitive programming team taught me about explaining ideas, sharing context, and helping strong people work independently.
- [What Happens After the Applause](https://vadimohka.com/essays/after-the-applause/): A startup competition creates opportunities. Teams still need a way to use them. My view of support after the final, informed by StartLab.
- [Recognizing Myself in My Work](https://vadimohka.com/essays/recognising-myself-in-my-work/): Personal taste, thoughtful details, and shared credit: why I want to understand my own choices and return to the things I have made.
